_howto: Newest first. The newest entry uses "build": "next"; CI swaps in the real build number. When adding an update, change the old "next" to its real build number, then add the new entry on top with "build": "next".

updates.title: Notification crash fix
notes: Fixed: Orbit closing when you tapped a message notification to open the chat

updates.title: Adjustable scroll speed
notes: New: Settings → Motion & feel → Scroll speed lets you make lists scroll as fast or slow as you like
Faster than normal by default — a flick carries further in chats, the inbox, contacts and recent calls

updates.title: Smart Reply crash fix + photo attachments
notes: Fixed for good: the app closing because of Google's on-device Smart Reply. The moment it crashes once, Orbit turns on-device Smart Reply off and keeps it off (turn it back on any time in AI & smart replies). Reply suggestions with an AI key are unaffected.
Photos people send over RCS now pull in from the notification's preview, so more of them show in the chat instead of just "Attachment"
Some RCS files still can't be reached (they live inside Google Messages) — those still open in Google Messages to view or download

updates.title: Call recordings in Settings
notes: New: Settings → Call recordings shows exactly where recordings are saved on your phone
Play, share or delete any recording right there
Save to phone copies a recording into your Music folder, where other apps can find it

updates.title: Dramatic fold + more blur (Phase 3)
notes: The Fold transition is now dramatic by default — a bigger 3D tilt and a deeper blur as screens fold in and out (still adjustable with the Fold intensity slider)
More blur throughout: the chat eases back behind the long-press menu, and the inbox blurs back behind its action menus, so what you tapped feels lifted in front
The blur everywhere follows your Fold intensity slider

updates.title: The Fold transition (Phase 2)
notes: New default look: screens now fold in and out in 3D with a depth blur, like the iPhone Duo's open/close animation — content stays anchored while the screen tilts around it
The whole app folds in when you open Orbit, and folds away when you close it
Settings → Motion & feel → Screen transition lets you pick Fold, Slide, Fade or Zoom
New Fold intensity slider, from Subtle to Dramatic
Turns itself off if you have Android's reduce-motion on, and skips the blur on older phones that can't do it

updates.title: Faster everywhere (Phase 1 of the speed + animation overhaul)
notes: Sending: your message confirms as sent noticeably quicker (the send loop reacts as soon as it can instead of in fixed steps)
Opening chats: the chats you're most likely to open are warmed up in the background and the one you tap is loaded the instant you tap it, so it opens instantly
Scrolling: chat bubbles do less repeated work while you scroll
Startup: the app opens faster — the slow setup work now happens just after launch instead of blocking the first screen
Next up: the iPhone Duo-style fold transition and smoother animations everywhere

updates.title: Attachments, Smart Reply crash fix, updates on Android 17
notes: Photos, videos and files people send over RCS now show in the chat instead of just "Attachment"
Tap any picture or file to open it full screen; long-press → Save to phone (Pictures, Movies or Download → Orbit folder)
If a file can't be pulled in, the bubble says what it is and opens that chat in Google Messages to see or download it
Picture texts open in your gallery app reliably (they used to fail with some viewers)
Fixed: Orbit closing while you were in a chat or got a text, caused by Google's Smart Reply (reply suggestions)
Smart Reply now uses one engine for the whole app and runs one suggestion at a time
Safety net: if Smart Reply ever closes Orbit twice on the same build, it turns itself off until the next update
Crash reports name the exact library that crashed, and old duplicate "no details" reports are removed
Fixed: "Self update is blocked by unknown source package" on Android 17. Orbit now hands the update to Android's installer (tap Install), and remembers to do that next time

updates.title: Update history
notes: New: Settings → Developer → Update history shows every update with patch notes
Shows updates newer than the one you have, so you can see what's coming before you install
Fixed: opening Crash & bug reports closed Orbit whenever it had reports in it
Every settings page is now opened by the automatic screen tests, to catch crashes like that before they ship

updates.title: Crash report tools
notes: Crash & bug reports: Copy all, Share all (.txt file) and Clear all (asks first)
Native crashes are now readable: crashed thread, backtrace, Android's log, and which part of the phone crashed
Older unreadable crash reports get re-read once
Crashes that happen while Orbit is out of memory still save a short report
Fixed the wrong "from before build 17" message

updates.title: Keyboard GIFs
notes: GIFs, stickers and images from Gboard or Samsung Keyboard now send straight from the chat box
Anything you typed goes along as the caption

updates.title: Full crash & bug reports
notes: Every crash and caught bug saves a full report with the reason in plain English
Settings → Crash & bug reports lists them all, with a pop-up for anything new
Caught bugs also send a notification
Background jobs can no longer crash the app
Camera and photo fixes
Update files swap in without a gap, so the download link never breaks mid-publish

updates.title: Reliable update checks
notes: Update checks read a small version file instead of GitHub's rate-limited API
Checks run every time Orbit opens
Clear messages when a check fails (offline, GitHub busy, build being published)

updates.title: Chat features, new call screen, easy setup, crash fixes
notes: Chat: swipe to reply, forward, multi-select, delete, hold-to-record voice notes
Chat: camera and video, GIF search, photo editor (draw, crop, rotate), send location, send a contact card
Chat: auto-scroll with a "↓ New message" pill
Inbox: mark all read and an icon badge count
Contacts: merge duplicates and your own QR code
Calls: new call screen, audio picker (phone, speaker, each Bluetooth device), add, merge and swap calls
Calls: "Text instead" for incoming calls, call recording with optional auto-record
Easy setup: one screen with one big button that always does the next thing
Fixed about 25 bugs, including a voice-message crash, an app-lock bypass and a widget call security hole

updates.title: Orbit: new name, black icon, 23 new features
notes: Contact Hub is now Orbit, with a black planet icon and 4 icons to pick from
Smart replies, "Catch me up" summaries and on-phone translation
Voice messages play in the bubble and turn into text
Snooze chats, search inside a chat, pinned messages, repeating scheduled texts
Birthday reminders, "haven't talked in a while" check-ins and relationship stats
Contact groups with colors and sounds, spam caller warnings, call notes
"Text when I arrive", today's Life360 trail, one-person home screen widgets
Text from your laptop over Wi-Fi, watch quick replies, shake to hide

updates.title: Simpler mock location, tappable links
notes: Mock location: full-screen map with a fixed pin and one big "Start here" button
Mock location: easier routes, saved and recent spots one tap away, change spots without stopping
Chats: links, phone numbers, emails and map spots are tappable
Link previews under messages, and "Select text" to copy part of a message

updates.title: Mock location fixes
notes: Fixed the "go to my real location" button
Asks for location permission instead of doing nothing
New red pin button jumps to the mock spot

updates.title: Mock location
notes: New: mock location in Settings → Developer
Single spots or routes that follow real roads, with speed presets
Favorites, recents, scheduled starts, Quick Settings tile and notification controls
Life360 shows you at the mock spot

updates.title: Send queue, double-tap reactions, curve studio
notes: Google Messages stays hidden while Orbit sends through it
Send messages back-to-back with a send queue; failed ones pause with Retry or Delete
Keyboard stays open after sending
Double-tap a message to react
Curve studio fixes, live previews and presets
Fixed Instagram, TikTok and Life360 sign-in pages

updates.title: Smoother app, page animations, friend sync
notes: Optimized build: much smaller and faster
Photos fly between screens, tabs slide, headers shrink as you scroll
"My curve" animation editor
Friend sync: link Instagram and TikTok follows to your contacts

updates.title: Faster chats, cleaner look
notes: Chats and the inbox open instantly and load older messages as you scroll
New clean look with large titles, pinned chats as circles and a pill text box
New contact card and round dial pad keys

updates.title: Settings fix
notes: Fixed Settings opening every sub-page by itself
Help for unlocking the blocked text-message permission

updates.title: v2: fixes and Contact Hub mode
notes: Fixed chats opening empty on Samsung
More reliable RCS sending and reactions
New mode where the app itself is your texting app (SMS and picture messages)
Step-by-step setup, Life360 sign-in, Google Drive backup, one-tap updates
Springy animations and a developer self-test

updates.title: First version
notes: Inbox with folders, pin, archive, mute, swipe actions and search
Chats through Google Messages with RCS, reactions and scheduled sends
Contact pages with socials, Life360, stats and shared media
Dialer with keypad, recents, favorites and blocking
Themes, app lock and daily backup
